name: truckwithease
description: TruckWithEase is a trucking operations interface prototype. Some screens use sample or simulated data. This app is not an FMCSA-certified ELD, does not provide certified eRODS transfers or DVIR attestations, and is not connected to Drivewyze bypass services or vehicle J1939 hardware. It does not guarantee regulatory compliance, safety, or availability. Verify information with official sources and configured providers before operational use. API and integration readiness is reported by /api/health.
